_notes.source: Live https://ftmo.com/en/ pricing (#pricing-2-step and #pricing-1-step, all five sizes) read in Chrome on 2026-10-20, https://ftmo.com/en/affiliate-programme/ and Google Maps. Earlier: screenshots of the live pricing page (2026-09-30).
_notes.pricing: Fees in EUR. The USD/EUR/GBP buttons on the pricing table choose the account currency (e.g. a $100,000 account); the fee itself is still shown in euros, so the file stays in EUR. standard = list price, promo = discounted price where one is shown: on 2026-10-20 only the $100K had a discount (1-Step EUR 399 instead of 499, 2-Step EUR 439 instead of 540), no code needed. All prices unchanged from 2026-09-30.
_notes.rule_units: Forex rules are % of account size. Futures rules are fixed USD amounts.
_notes.null_means: Field not shown on the pricing page. Check the firm's 'View Rules' page before publishing.
_notes.company_check: https://ftmo.com/en/about-us/ (checked 2026-10-11): 'Since 2015' and 'operating from our headquarters in the heart of Prague'; footer 'FTMO s.r.o.'.
_notes.not_listed: FTMO now also sells an 'FTMO Instant Account' (new, no evaluation) and FTMO Futures (separate pricing page). Neither is listed here yet.
_notes.min_trading_days: 1-Step: the pricing table shows no minimum-trading-days row (2-Step shows 4 days), so min_trading_days stays null for 1-Step.
_notes.affiliate_program: https://ftmo.com/en/affiliate-programme/ (2026-10-20): four levels by monthly commission, each kept for 3 months (FTMO CFD / futures evaluations / futures resets) - Bronze (start, EUR 0): 8% / 10% / 5%; Silver (EUR 250 a month): 10% / 12% / 6% plus a custom affiliate code; Gold (EUR 1,000): 15% / 15% / 7.5% plus a free $50K challenge; Platinum (EUR 2,500): 20% / 18% / 9% plus a free $100K challenge. CFD commission is one-time per product per referred trader; futures subscription/reset commission for up to 12 months. Commissions approved immediately once referrals trade; paid by bank transfer, Skrill or crypto. Cookie length not stated. Nationals and residents of Pakistan, Vietnam and certain other countries are not eligible; the UAE is selectable in the sign-up form. Comparison sites not mentioned. Apply: the 'Join FTMO Affiliate Programme' form on that page.

firm.name: FTMO
firm.about: FTMO is a Prague-based prop trading firm founded in 2015, and one of the largest firms in the industry. It offers 1-Step and 2-Step forex challenges on MT4, MT5 and cTrader.

countries.notes: List is for FTMO CFD (forex) challenges. Iran, Syria, Myanmar and North Korea are banned by nationality as well as residence, but nationals of Iran, Syria or Myanmar living in the EEA with a traditional EEA bank account may be accepted (no exception for North Korea). Ukraine is only restricted in Crimea, Sevastopol, Donetsk, Kherson, Luhansk and Zaporizhzhia. Kosovo is coded XK (widely used, not an official ISO code). US residents are not served on ftmo.com but can join through FTMO US (ftmo.oanda.com); Australians use ftmo.com/au. FTMO Futures has its own, longer list (it also excludes China, for example, and five US states: AR, DE, LA, MT, SC). People on sanctions lists or with financial-crime records are also refused. FTMO may change this list.
